assertions.assert: Each element (message_for_turn, relationship_for_input, participant_for_source, fail_turn, detector_refs, new_track_ref, content_for_detector, complete_turn, ingest_content, on_end, turn_participants) takes exactly its declared attributes, the required ones present and none empty, message_for_turn's direction exactly inbound or outbound, and no content, and the namespace has no other element: a malformed element raises error.execution and assigns nothing (its schema, package/conversation.xsd, rejects it before any run under scx validate).

<conversation:message_for_turn> writes the committed message {sequence, direction, source_ids, target_ids, content, content_type, provenance}, without the message's other members: inbound audio content is null, other content is kept as given, and absent content is null; a provenance's id, source, target and session_ref are taken when they are strings, else null, and its turn_ref is taken as given; without a session_ref an inbound message's is relationship-<its relationship context reference> and an outbound one's null.

<conversation:relationship_for_input> writes the index of the input's relationship: targetless input shares the first ambient relationship, other input the best scoring one in either direction (names equal, embeddings at least 0.85 alike, one to one); with none it appends a relationship whose context_ref is {"identity_groups":[...]} over the sorted identity groups, whose session_ref is relationship- and that, and whose participants and sequences are empty.

<conversation:participant_for_source> adds the source to the relationship's participants once, <conversation:fail_turn> drops it, and <conversation:detector_refs> writes [session_ref, participant] of every participant, ordered by session_ref and then identity.

<conversation:new_track_ref> writes a name as its own track, an embedding as track- and its unit vector's JSON, and null for no source; <conversation:content_for_detector> writes the stimulus that opens the source's turn: text/plain string content as a text stimulus, audio/* string content as an audio stimulus with its rate and channels, anything else as a content stimulus.

<conversation:complete_turn> writes the inbound message of the turns' product: their texts joined by spaces as text/plain when any has text, each distinct text once; else no content for audio/*; else the input's content; with the first turn's turn_ref and the given session_ref.

<conversation:ingest_content> takes a stimulus into the open turn's content (a text's stripped text when not empty, an audio chunk with the first rate and channels, a content, an event as application/event; an image changes nothing), and <conversation:on_end> writes the closed turn {turn} with its text, audio or content, or {failure} at stage turn when it has neither text, audio nor content, or both text and audio.

A value of the wrong kind (relationships that are not an array of relationships, a source that is not an identity, no turns, a stimulus that is not an object or null) raises error.execution and assigns nothing.

<conversation:turn_participants> writes the participants a cognition handoff stamps for the turn: the input's string identities, source_ids as sources then target_ids as targets, each group in the original's identity order, then the parent's data's participants, each once, at most 32; an embedding, an empty name, or a name over 200 characters is never stamped; an input without source_ids and target_ids, or carried participants that are not {ref, role}, raise error.execution and assign nothing.
